configChanges: Service-to-service calls use in-cluster Service addresses

In `.env.production`, the `*_SERVICE_URL` values for MASTER, CLIENT_WS, CLIENT_METADATA, NOTIFICATION, WORKFLOW, SEARCH, TEMPLATE, CHAT now point at the; in-cluster Services (`http://cadp-backend-<name>.cadp-dev.svc.cluster.local/<context-path>`); instead of `https://cadp.cavininfotech.com/<context-path>`. Browser-facing values (CORS, frontend,; approval and subdomain URLs) and external hosts are unchanged. `BACKUP_SERVICE_URL` stays public: no k8s Service for it in the repo.

Calls between services in the `cadp-dev` namespace were leaving the cluster through the; public load balancer and nginx ingress with a TLS handshake each time. Calling the ClusterIP; Service directly removes those hops. Ingress no longer applies to these calls, so its body-size; limit and 60s read timeout do not either; the app's own limits and axios timeouts apply.; If the `cadp-dev-env` k8s secret defines any of these keys, its value takes precedence.
